visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit indoor gym setting. A muscular male with blonde hair and a beard, wearing a black t-shirt with a cartoon graphic and grey shorts, stands facing a female with long dark hair and glasses. She is dressed in a white cropped t-shirt and baggy denim jeans, holding a black clipboard and pen. She points the pen at the male while speaking, her facial expression serious. (2) Through a series of straight cuts, the camera captures medium shots and close-ups of the two individuals. The female gestures with her hands while talking, and the male responds with a neutral, stoic expression. The background contains various gym equipment, including racks of colorful weight plates and lifting machines. Yellow captions are visible at the top of the screen. (3) The setting remains the same as the female asks more questions, looking down at her clipboard briefly. The male uses his hands to signal numbers, specifically showing two and then three fingers. The lighting is uniform and bright across the scene. (4) In the concluding phase, the female's expression shifts to one of excitement and joy. She puts down her clipboard and vigorously shakes the male's hand. They both appear animated. Subtitles at the bottom confirm the change in tone. The camera remains mostly static at eye-level throughout these shots.
